'''Zeta Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] unit that flew [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they fought rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin coup forces|splinter government]] [[Zaarin's fleet|fleet]] in [[Zaarin insurrection|his insurrection]].
